architecture.communication: Firebase Hosting PWA <--HTTPS JSON / CORS + JWT--> Render Java 21 Spring Boot <--TLS/SSL JDBC Pool (HikariCP)--> Neon Serverless PostgreSQL

frontend.stack: BookMyShow / Snabbit Style PWA (HTML5, Tailwind CSS, ES Modules, Razorpay Standard Checkout)

features: Spring Security stateless JWT auth and strict Firebase Hosting CORS policy
Dual OTP KYC, dynamic off-peak/odd-hour paise pricing, Razorpay Orders & HMAC SHA-256 webhooks
Caffeine in-memory read caching and 60s BookingHoldExpiryScheduler

database.engine: PostgreSQL 15/16 (Neon) with H2 PostgreSQL compatibility fallback for local tests
features: 13-table relational schema (monetary amounts in BIGINT paise, timestamps in BIGINT epoch ms)
10-minute ACID slot hold locks enforced via UNIQUE (resource_id, booking_date, start_time) on apex_slot_locks
Idempotent Razorpay webhook deduplication in apex_webhook_events & immutable audit trail

apex-pm.name: Project Manager & Spec Kitty Controller
duties: Enforce Spec Kitty SDD lifecycle (specify -> plan -> tasks -> implement)
Coordinate deliverables across Business Analyst (apex-ba) and Technical Lead (apex-tech-lead)
Maintain kanban work package lanes (backlog, doing, review, done) and milestone status reports
Audit compliance against Zero Cloud Functions, Spark Tier quotas, and 3-tier Firebase/Render/Neon mandates

apex-ba.name: Business Analyst
duties: Conduct Indian sports-tech market research across Mumbai, Thane, and Navi Mumbai (Playo, Hudle, Turf Town benchmarking)
Author and govern Business Requirements Document (docs/brd.md), PRD (docs/prd.md), and Feature Spec (spec.md)
Define and enforce BA-01 through BA-08 business rules (Dual OTP KYC, Owner Onboarding, Dynamic Pricing, 10-min ACID Hold, Razorpay Webhooks, 3-Tier Cancellation, Gate QR, Cloud SLA)
Specify Given-When-Then acceptance criteria and traceability matrices

apex-tech-lead.name: Technical Lead
duties: Own end-to-end 3-tier integration across Firebase Hosting, Render Java 21 middleware, and Neon Serverless PostgreSQL
Govern REST API contracts (/api/v1/*), JWT RBAC boundaries, CORS policies, and Razorpay webhook contracts
Coordinate apex-ui, apex-java, and apex-db on schema alignment, paise ledger precision, and ACID concurrency
Validate multi-tier resilience, cold-start behavior, and end-to-end acceptance workflows

apex-ui.name: UI Expert
apex-ui.role: Tier 1 — BookMyShow/Snabbit PWA on Firebase Hosting
duties: Build and maintain BookMyShow & Snabbit styled responsive Web/PWA UI on Firebase Hosting
Implement Venue Explorer, interactive Slot Grid with odd-hour badges, Checkout countdown modal, Player Portal, and Owner Gate Portal
Integrate Tier 2 Render REST endpoints via src/services/apiClient.js and Razorpay Standard Checkout
Maintain Firebase Hosting routing (firebase.json), PWA manifest.json, and offline service worker sw.js

apex-java.name: Java Developer
apex-java.role: Tier 2 — Java 21 Spring Boot Middleware on Render
apex-java.tier: Tier 2: Middleware (Render Docker / Java 21 Spring Boot)
duties: Implement Java 21 LTS + Spring Boot 3.2.x REST middleware containerized for Render deployment
Enforce Spring Security JWT auth, Dual OTP KYC, dynamic pricing in integer paise, and Razorpay HMAC SHA-256 verification
Configure NeonDataSourceConfig HikariCP SSL pooling, Caffeine caching, and 60s BookingHoldExpiryScheduler
Maintain Render deployment blueprint (render.yaml) and multi-stage backend/Dockerfile

apex-db.name: Database Expert
apex-db.role: Tier 3 — Neon Serverless PostgreSQL Schema & ACID Locks
duties: Own 13-table Neon Serverless PostgreSQL schema with H2 PostgreSQL compatibility in backend/src/main/resources/db/schema.sql
Enforce ACID double-booking prevention via UNIQUE (resource_id, booking_date, start_time) on apex_slot_locks
Guarantee BIGINT integer paise financial precision, UTC epoch timestamps, and webhook idempotency keys
Maintain data-model.md specifications and legacy Firestore security rules/indexes during transition
